name: sticker-foundry
description: Sticker Foundry development checks and browser tests.

scripts.test:backend: uv run --project apps/backend pytest apps/backend/tests -m "not integration" -q
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project apps/backend ruff check apps/backend/foundry apps/backend/tests
scripts.test:live: uv run --project apps/backend pytest apps/backend/tests/test_live.py -m integration -q
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project apps/backend uvicorn foundry.main:app --app-dir apps/backend --reload --port 3000
